summary: Route one outbound notification and decide suppress/send/batch.

input_schema.actor: string | optional | Actor identity for routing context. Defaults to 'operator'.
input_schema.channel: string | optional | Channel identifier. Defaults to service routing default.
input_schema.title: string | optional | Optional title rendered above message content.
input_schema.message: string | The notification body to route.
input_schema.dedupe_key: string | optional | Suppress duplicate sends within configured dedupe window.
input_schema.batch_key: string | optional | Queue into batch instead of immediate send.
input_schema.force: boolean | optional | Bypass dedupe, batch, and rate-limit suppression checks. Defaults to false.

output_schema.decision: string | Router decision outcome: sent, suppressed, or batched.
output_schema.delivered: boolean | Whether a message was delivered to channel.
output_schema.suppressed_reason: string | optional | Suppression reason when decision is suppressed.
output_schema.batched_count: integer | optional | Pending item count when decision is batched.
output_schema.notification: object | optional | Normalized routed notification payload.
